name: EXS Lubricant - Chocolate Flavored Water Based Lubricant 5ml x 4 Pouch - Travel/Honeymoon Pack
description:
Indulge in smooth, flavorful intimacy with EXS Chocolate Flavored Lubricant, a premium water-based formula designed for comfort, safety, and long-lasting pleasure. Compact and convenient, perfect for on-the-go use.

Key Features:

Chocolate Flavored: Adds a fun, delicious flavor for a more enjoyable experience.

Water-Based & Non-Tacky: Smooth, easy-to-clean, and natural-feeling lubrication.

Long-Lasting: Provides extended lubrication without stickiness.

Condom Compatible: Safe to use with latex condoms for worry-free intimacy.

Paraben-Free & Skin-Friendly: Gentle on sensitive skin for safe application.

Specifications:

Brand: EXS (UK Based)

Pack Size: 4 x 5ml Pouches

Made In: Turkey

Ingredients: Hydroxy Ethyl Cellulose, Glycerin, Monopropylene Glycol, Citric Acid, Sodium Saccharin, Methyl Hydroxybenzoate, Deionized Water

Experience safe, smooth, and pleasurable moments with EXS Chocolate Flavored Lubricant — the perfect combination of flavor and comfort.
